name: Eyes on Earth — Overweight Armored Probe
description: Failing test fixture: excessive spacecraft mass. The spacecraft configuration isolates a clean mass violation where all other constraints (power, communications, budget, and orbit compatibility) pass, but total assembled mass exceeds Launcher Alpha's 50 kg payload capacity.

expectedScore.note: Feasibility fails at FC-2 (Mass compliance). Regardless of individual suitability scores, the spacecraft cannot be lifted into orbit by the selected launch vehicle.

failureExplanation: The total spacecraft mass of 55.0 kg exceeds Launcher Alpha's maximum payload capacity of 50.0 kg by 5.0 kg (+10% overload). The primary contributor to the mass overload is the Reinforced Satellite Bus (28.0 kg). To resolve this failure, the player must either select a lighter structure (e.g. Small Satellite Bus at 8.0 kg) or upgrade to a more powerful launch vehicle (Launcher Beta with 150 kg payload capacity).
